jobs.overlay_text: 凝汽器与真空系统 · 第3组
negative_constraints: sealed tube wall separates media

hotwell remains below tubes
air extraction branch separate from main steam inlet

pump shown as system block; no invented impeller cutaway
jobs.motion_policy: symbolic indicators move; all metal geometry remains fixed
acceptance: professional approval required before video production
